name: systo
description: The skills Systo's operators use on client work. Design systems, static creative, motion graphics and scroll-driven 3D.

plugins.name: systo
plugins.description: All seven Systo skills: artboard (recut, rebrand and generate static creative), swipefile (capture a site's design system by measurement), manifesto (replicate a motion-graphics video frame for frame), motion-brief (write the brief before anything is built), motion-graphics-director (decide how much pipeline a video actually needs), hyperframes-render-discipline (six verification habits for render work), threejs-scroll-sites (scroll-driven 3D and an idle render governor).
